description: An office company makes desks and drawers. Each desk requires 40 minutes of assembly and 20 minutes of sanding. Each drawer requires 30 minutes of assembly and 10 minutes of sanding. The company has available 4000 minutes for assembly and 3500 minutes for sanding. If the profit per desk is $100 and the profit per drawer is $90, how many of each should the company make to maximize profit?

AssemblyTimeDesk.definition: Minutes required for assembly per desk

SandingTimeDesk.definition: Minutes required for sanding per desk

AssemblyTimeDrawer.definition: Minutes required for assembly per drawer

SandingTimeDrawer.definition: Minutes required for sanding per drawer

objective.description: "The goal is to maximize the total profit from producing desks and drawers"

constraints.description: 40 * (number of desks) + 30 * (number of drawers) must be less than or equal to 4000 (total assembly time constraint)
The number of desks produced must be greater than or equal to 0
The number of drawers produced must be greater than or equal to 0
The number of desks and drawers produced must be integers
